"""Overlapping leases, per-lease evidence scoping and misc edge cases."""
import base64, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from harness import run,check_plan
import ref, ipaddress
from gen_targets import canary_iid

HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
        'result,service,attempt,payload')
P='2001:db8:1:1200::/56'
N1='2001:db8:1:1200::'
A={'id':'A','prefix':P,'start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}
B={'id':'B','prefix':P,'start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}

def campaign(rows,leases=(A,B),queries=(10,),services=({'id':'web','kind':'tcp'},),
             requests=(),offers=()):
    data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':list(leases),'services':list(services),
            'queries':list(queries),
            'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}],
            'requests':list(requests),'offers':list(offers),
            'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':9}],
            'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':9}]}

def lease(out,name):
    for e in out['snapshots'][0]['leases']:
        if e['lease']==name: return e
    raise KeyError(name)

fails=[]
def check(label,got,want):
    if got!=want:
        fails.append(label); print('FAIL',label,'got',got,'want',want)

# evidence in lease A does not join lease B even with identical planning
rows=[f'icmp,x,0,5,put,A,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,']
out=run(campaign(rows))
check('A internal',lease(out,'A')['internal'],[N1+'1'])
check('B internal',lease(out,'B')['internal'],[])
check('B unresolved',lease(out,'B')['unresolved'],[N1+'1',N1+'2'])
check('ledger',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],{'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0})

# identical planning means both manifests list the same targets
check('manifest overlap',[m['target'] for m in out['manifest']],
      [m['target'] for m in out['manifest'][:3]]*1)
check('manifest count',len(out['manifest']),6)

# a request on lease B is not active from lease A evidence
job=campaign(rows,[{'id':'r1','at':10,'lease':'B','target':N1+'1','service':'web','group':'g'}],
             [{'id':'o1','time':11,'service':'web','prefix':P,'capacity':1,'cost':1,
               'group':'o','requests':['r1']}])
out=run(job)
check('request on B inactive',{a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']},
      {'r1':False})
check('plan empty',out['plan']['resolved'],0)
job=campaign(rows,[{'id':'r1','at':10,'lease':'A','target':N1+'1','service':'web','group':'g'}],
             [{'id':'o1','time':11,'service':'web','prefix':P,'capacity':1,'cost':1,
               'group':'o','requests':['r1']}])
out=run(job)
check('request on A active',{a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']},
      {'r1':True})
check_plan(job,out['plan'],{a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']})

# an aliased lease quarantines both roles and leaves unresolved lows
canA=str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(N1+''))
                               +canary_iid('demo','A','2001:db8:1:1200::/64')))
rows=[f'icmp,x,0,5,put,A,1,0/c,{canA},{canA},echo,,,',
      f'icmp,y,0,5,put,A,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,',
      f'icmp,z,0,5,put,A,1,0/i2,{N1}2,{N1}9,echo,,,']
e=lease(run(campaign(rows)),'A')
check('alias state',e['state'],'alias')
check('alias fields',(e['conflicts'],e['internal'],e['external'],e['unresolved']),
      ([],[],
       [],[N1+'1',N1+'2']))

# multiple queries produce snapshots in increasing order with distinct ledgers
rows=[f'icmp,x,0,5,put,A,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,',
      f'icmp,x,1,20,delete,,,,,,,,,']
out=run(campaign(rows,queries=(5,10,20,30)))
check('snapshot order',[s['at'] for s in out['snapshots']],[5,10,20,30])
check('ledger seq',[s['ledger']['live'] for s in out['snapshots']],[1,1,0,0])
check('deleted seq',[s['ledger']['deleted'] for s in out['snapshots']],[0,0,1,1])
# the request activity is frozen per query
job=campaign([f'icmp,x,0,5,put,A,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,',
              f'app,p,0,30,put,A,1,,{N1}1,,open,web,0,'],
             requests=[{'id':'r1','at':10,'lease':'A','target':N1+'1','service':'web','group':'g'},
                       {'id':'r2','at':30,'lease':'A','target':N1+'1','service':'web','group':'g'}],
             offers=[],queries=(10,30))
out=run(job)
check('frozen',{a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']},{'r1':True,'r2':False})

# reference agreement on the overlapping lease scenario
for rows in ([f'icmp,x,0,5,put,A,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,'],
             [f'icmp,x,0,5,put,A,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,',
              f'icmp,y,0,5,put,B,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}9,echo,,,']):
    job=campaign(rows)
    mine=run(job); theirs=ref.run(job)
    for key in ('manifest','rejected','snapshots','active_requests'):
        if mine[key]!=theirs[key]:
            fails.append('ref '+key); print('FAIL ref',key)
print('edge tests done, failures:',len(fails))
PYEOF
python3 tmp/t_edge.py
